source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Kenji,

Although the three reference lines are useful for evaluating the second V and the accent, this iteration has completely lost the Hero V—the foundation of the entire system.

Please respect both our time by ensuring that the Hero V, along with the established proportions of the second V and accent, continues to follow the rules we have already agreed upon.

The next round should address only the following:

Restore the Hero V.
Finalize its terminal language so it is softer, but not calligraphic.
After those elements are correct, transfer them to the É accent and then apply them proportionally to the second V.

Whenever the foundation disappears, the project moves 3 steps backward. Until the Hero V is restored and the VvÉ hierarchy is reestablished, every other consideration is secondary.
